business_impact.claim: The fix acquires refresh credentials around visibility transitions and reconciles expired deadlines on return.
business_impact.business_effect: Improve recovery after a background interval and reduce repeated authentication.
limits: This is the intended benefit and inspected source path. It does not establish complete background recovery.
business_impact.next_action: Require passing intended background recovery assertions for the selected candidate and environment.

business_impact.claim: Refresh expiry can show Timeout while renewed access remains valid.
business_impact.business_effect: Active portal work can be interrupted by logout and fresh sign-in.
limits: The retained comparison controls timing and provider responses. Production occurrence frequency is unknown.
Unsaved-work loss and financial loss were not demonstrated.
business_impact.next_action: Resolve the active-cutoff condition or record an explicit, scoped business disposition under the actual release policy.

business_impact.claim: Late session credentials and delayed refresh delivery can prevent recovery or clear a subsequent fresh session.
business_impact.business_effect: Users can face repeated authentication and interrupted portal access.
limits: No unauthorized data access, attacker exploit, financial loss, or production rate was demonstrated.
Delayed recovery is inherited. Prior existence does not establish acceptance.
business_impact.next_action: Require stale-response rejection and intended delayed-recovery outcomes before acceptance.

system_impact.claim: The Home lifecycle and shared credential store affect authenticated portal sessions.
system_impact.reach: Users loading the selected @fm/base runtime can encounter these paths.
limits: Actual deployed population and source-to-artifact identity are unknown.
No user-scoped session-fix flag was established in the inspected lifecycle.
system_impact.next_action: Identify rollout population, deployed import-map version, and effective containment controls.

system_impact.claim: The shell exports shared HTTP and extension services to embedded consumers.
system_impact.reach: Supplied Cashflow Blotter and Ratan container source call the exported extension service after query completion.
limits: These links do not prove polling frequency or deployed versions.
The latest user correction selects Cashflow Blotter. The earlier Dashboard-specific causal explanation was withdrawn.

system_impact.claim: Access, refresh, and absolute deadlines depend on backend-issued metadata and effective configuration.
system_impact.reach: Source declares fifteen-minute access and 225-minute refresh durations. app.conf declares a 480-minute access override.
system_impact.relationship_class: confirmed source declarations and source behavior
limits: Effective PROD configuration, property origin, backend version, token lifetime and clock agreement remain unknown.
The frontend timer is based on JWT expiry. Thirty minutes is not an approved replacement constant.
system_impact.next_action: Retain effective property origins, exp-minus-iat metadata, refresh deadlines and comparable clocks for the deployed release.

system_impact.claim: The current BFF checkout has broader changes beyond the BFF used by retained session fixtures.
system_impact.reach: The selected current BFF comparison changes authentication filters, entitlements, configuration and a migration among 62 files.
limits: The user requested an MFE fix. The current BFF checkout is not assumed to be included in that release.
A combined-current-checkout release was not verified by the historical BFF fixtures.
system_impact.next_action: Declare the actual PROD BFF and dependency versions. Assess combined changes only if included.

operational_findings.claim: The inspected task does not bind an immutable PROD candidate artifact to the reviewed source.
operational_findings.consequence: A production readiness claim cannot identify the bytes or release composition being promoted.
operational_findings.next_action: Retain the release ID, successful build, artifact digest, source provenance, configuration and exact deployed dependency inventory.

operational_findings.claim: Production configuration parity is not established.
operational_findings.consequence: Local timing outcomes cannot establish target timeout or recovery behavior.
operational_findings.next_action: Bind effective target settings and issued lifetimes without retaining full credentials.

operational_findings.claim: Deployment and rollback source exists, but its current applicability and execution are unproven.
operational_findings.consequence: Historical rollback parameters cannot establish recovery for this release.
operational_findings.next_action: Select the active Ansible or other approved pipeline. Retain current rollback artifact, procedure, operator, triggers and validation evidence.

operational_findings.claim: Source contains static HTTP probes and session analytics events.
operational_findings.consequence: These declarations do not establish working business-level alerts or timely incident response.
operational_findings.next_action: Retain target session-success and failure signals, sourced stop thresholds, alert checks and responsible operators.

operational_findings.claim: Existing runbooks and knowledge do not establish a current approved PROD procedure or sign-off.
operational_findings.consequence: The release authority and required acceptance decisions remain unresolved.
operational_findings.next_action: Identify the governing release process and actual technical, business, and deployment decision owners.

operational_findings.claim: Rolling back frontend bytes cannot by itself restore a session already ended by logout.
operational_findings.consequence: Users may still need fresh sign-in after reversal. Existing delayed-recovery behavior can remain.
operational_findings.next_action: Define post-rollback session recovery and validate affected journeys. Do not claim rollback repairs unmeasured workflow state.
